title: Final velocity value
description: Essential: Correctly calculates final velocity as 12 m/s using v = at.

title: Final displacement value
description: Essential: Correctly calculates displacement as 24 m using s = ½at².

title: Velocity equation application
description: Important: Applies the correct kinematic equation v = u + at, with u = 0.

title: Displacement equation application
description: Important: Applies the correct kinematic equation s = ut + ½at², with u = 0.

title: Units in final answer
description: Optional: Includes correct units (m/s and m) with numerical answers.

title: Sign or formula confusion
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect formula (e.g., s = at² instead of ½at²) or misplaces the ½ factor.

title: Initial condition oversight
description: Pitfall: Fails to use initial velocity u = 0 when applying kinematic equations.
